$comment: The rule table of the crate-boundary gate.
Source of truth: docs/design/BUILD-CONTRACT.md §1.1 and §3, and
Change this file only together with an ADR (BUILD-CONTRACT §8, X-2).
crateAllow  - exact crate id -> the crates it may depend on.
'*' matches every crate of the workspace.
'<area>/*' matches every crate of that area.
areaAllow   - the fallback for a crate that is not listed in crateAllow.
exceptions  - additional edges that are allowed although the table
forbids them, each with a written reason.

platform/phomu-capi.reason: The C-ABI bridge reuses the wire model, the registry and the error mapping of the UniFFI bridge: the two bridges export the same surface and must not drift apart (BUILD-CONTRACT § 2.1). See docs/adr/ADR-0008-abi-version-and-the-exported-surface.md.
